_comment: Config for the EditorConfig job in .github/workflows/lint.yml.
Exclude: LICENSE and fonts/OFL.txt are verbatim licence texts that
AGENTS.md says stay byte-identical to what the licensor published, so
they are not ours to reindent. languages/*.mo is a compiled gettext
catalogue, i.e. binary. Image and font binaries need no entry here:
editorconfig-checker skips them through its own default excludes.
Disable.Indentation: .editorconfig sets indent_style = tab for every
file, and the checker is line-based, so it cannot tell a space-indented
declaration from an aligned continuation line inside a block comment.
Turned on against this tree it reports 18 findings, and most are the
second kind -- comment alignment in style.css and editor-style.css,
indented code fences in Markdown, the shell command in the pull request
template -- which are correct as they stand.
Be clear about the cost, because the first draft of this file was not:
PHPCS does NOT pick the gap up. It runs on .php only and on changed
files only, so indentation in style.css is checked by nothing, and
style.css:916-918 is genuinely space-indented today. That is a real
gap and worth its own issue, not something this file covers.
What is left here still catches the things that bite regardless of
file type: CRLF, missing final newlines, trailing whitespace and
non-UTF-8 bytes.
